spans.s:
. pl. इल॑यता, AV. i, 17, 4) or एलयति (Pāṇ. iii, 1, 51) aor. ऐलिलत् or ऐलयीत्, to keep still, not to move;
to become quiet, AV.; TS.; ŚBr. &c.;
[a various reading has the form इळ्: cf. Old Germ. îllu, îllo, for îlju; Mod. Germ. Eile; Cambro-Brit. il, ‘progress, motion’; Gk. ἐλάω]
Caus. P. ईल॑यति, to move, TS. vi, 4, 2, 6 (cf. ईर्, Caus.)
